en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a large multi-storey corner hotel building with many windows and enclosed balconies, set on a wide street intersection. Pedestrians, carriages or early vehicles are visible near the entrance. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Port Said and the building as the Eastern Exchange Hôtel. Vertical printing along the side credits a publisher in Cairo.
